title: Bread in the Meadow
lines: Sam wanted to have lunch in the meadow.
Dad said yes, so they packed a bag.
The bag was heavy. Sam had to tug it.
The weather was hot on top of his head.
They spread a red rug on the grass.
Dad got the fresh bread and a jug.
A crow sat up in the tree and looked.
It left a feather. Then it took the bread!
Sam ran after it, but the crow flew off.
"We have no lunch," said Dad. Sam sat.
Then Sam went back to the heavy bag.
He looked in it. Dad had packed more!
There was a second bread and some plums.
They ate, and the crow got its bread.

questions.ask: What did the crow leave, and what did it take?
questions.listenFor: It left a feather and took the bread. Listen for both.

questions.ask: Why was the bag so heavy?
questions.listenFor: Dad had packed a second bread and plums. Have them find that line.

questions.ask: What would you have said to that crow? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any idea is fine if it fits the story. Listen for a reason.
